goal: Identify out-of-sample function classes where tiny Householder view codes meaningfully reuse one shared nonlinear core; separate feasibility from optimization and deployment
not_in_scope: unseen task data used for selection

teacher_generation.positive_control: separate intentionally Householder-aligned teacher; excluded from primary hypothesis
teacher_generation.function_labels: Analytic target functions with task-related base and independently drawn perturbations; independently initialized ordinary dense MLP teachers fitted from labels; no Householder or Mirror construction
no_leakage: teacher weights not given to student
target task generation coefficients not given to student
new task identities and function-generation seeds sealed for confirmation

candidate_model.Mirror: Q_m=I-2u_m u_m^T with ||u_m||=1; f_m(x)=B Q_m^T sigma(Q_m(Ax+b))+c
candidate_model.view_selector: external task ID available identically to all arms; cost and metadata counted

controls: coupled-rank1 with unconstrained beta/view (strict superset of Mirror)
small independent width-6 and width-7 byte-brackets
independent full-width upper bound (not comparable byte budget)

L0.purpose: separate pilot tasks and calibration; no Fresh/OOD
requirements: test activation-scale and condition-code gradients on genuine input distribution
verify teacher trained independently, no Mirror-derived primary tasks
verify minimum non-saturated baseline; absolute loss-gain thresholds achievable; otherwise stop before freeze

L1.purpose: fit task code against frozen shared core and estimate allowed functional approximation in DEV-only worlds

L2.purpose: only after freeze, confirm independently generated task identities and function families
L2.holdout: No hidden target task generation coefficients, teacher weights, or Fresh targets used to choose hyperparameters
L2.note: No L2 without a frozen protocol and preflight passed

candidate_decision_policy.quality: Report paired log-NMSE ratios Mirror/FiLM and Mirror/coupled-rank1, including joint-training and frozen-core fitting as different evidence lanes
candidate_decision_policy.classification: The trained Mirror may win from better inductive bias even though coupled-rank1 strictly includes it; do not claim representational strict superset
candidate_decision_policy.pilot: Require baseline to be above a fixed non-saturation floor to avoid impossible absolute improvement tests; final floor/threshold to be preregistered before training
candidate_decision_policy.progression: If all new non-Mirror teacher families give no competitive functional-orbit fit vs simpler controls, stop before expensive joint training; positive control does not override this gate

metrics_and_uncertainty.primary: paired per-task Fresh macro NMSE on new task identities, selected without Fresh
other: forward median/IQR and training-wall across seeds
metrics_and_uncertainty.sample_minimum: DEV >=5 independent task-family seeds; confirm >=10 new task-family seeds
metrics_and_uncertainty.error_u_c: s(log(Mirror/control paired NMSE))/sqrt(n), report n and distribution; no normal-theory 95% claim at n=5
metrics_and_uncertainty.coverage: Teacher task families, input distribution and normalization must be fixed before freeze

next_stage: Separate experiment ID only after L2: shared-Mirror+private rank [0,1,2,4] vs matched FiLM+private/coupled-rank1+private; no private capacity free.
